node.title: Re^2: Getting query string with CGI::Fast
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Also, I think you want an if, not a while

No, that's how you're supposed to use [mod://CGI::Fast], as a glance into the documentation would have told you. The whole point of FCGI is a persistent process.

strict/warnings would not have caught the infinite loop tho

It would?

 (Somehow I missed the "not" in that sentence, my apologies.)
Maybe nodes{ exists $nodes{$query} ? $query : '_err' }(); needs to be nodes{ exists $nodes{$query} ? $query : '_err' }->();

No.

[hippo]'s [id://11119890|answer] is correct: The problem is there are two [mod://CGI] objects in the program.
